solution.title: Intune Administrative Governance — RBAC & Multi-Admin Approval

products.name: Intune Administrative Governance — RBAC & Multi-Admin Approval — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement Intune administrative governance — least-privilege custom RBAC roles and scope tags, plus multi-admin approval (access policies) so high-risk changes need a second admin. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Put real guardrails on Intune — least-privilege roles and a second pair of eyes on risky changes

When everyone is an Intune Administrator, mistakes and blast radius follow. Modern governance means least-privilege RBAC and multi-admin approval for the changes that can break a fleet. This solution implements Intune administrative governance: custom RBAC roles and scope tags that limit who can touch what, plus access policies (multi-admin approval) so high-risk actions — like app or script deployments — require a second admin to approve before they go live.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Intune RBAC model (built-in vs custom roles, permissions, scope tags, scope groups), the multi-admin approval / access-policy model, and how the two combine into least-privilege governance.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, an admin-role design, scope-tag taxonomy, approver groups, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: design roles and scope tags, create custom RBAC roles and assignments, apply scope tags to objects, enable access policies (multi-admin approval) for high-risk resource types, validate approvals, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — RBAC/scope-tag and access-policy discovery, role-assignment and approval validation, a governance-coverage and privilege report, safe remediation of over-privileged assignments, and an admin/approver scope-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Intune locked down to least privilege — custom roles and scope tags limiting who can touch what, and a required second-admin approval on high-risk changes — so mistakes and blast radius shrink, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • RBACGOV-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Intune roles, scope tags, role assignments, and access policies
    • RBACGOV-Remediation.ps1 — safely tighten over-privileged Intune role assignments (-WhatIf default)
    • RBACGOV-Report.ps1 — governance-coverage and over-privilege report for Intune administration
    • RBACGOV-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the admin and approver scope groups for Intune governance
    • RBACGOV-Validation.ps1 — validate role assignments and multi-admin approval policies vs design

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
